text: 1009 changes Migrator to use localization_dir directly instead of appending the locale. 1010's test prepares an en-US clone and passes that root to fluent.migratetb.tool together with --lang en-US. Keep the caller and vendored fork directory contract coordinated; appending en-US at both ends would describe a different path. The fork's package name and release-artifact spelling also differ, so package metadata is not a filename template. No recipe execution was run.
title: Pass the actual localization directory to the Thunderbird Fluent fork
